# LogLens AI

> LogLens AI is a free, open-source, self-hosted AI log analyzer and monitoring
> tool. It reads logs where they already live, flags the few lines that signal a
> real failure, and explains each one in plain language — without uploading a
> single log line. MIT-licensed. Runs on Linux, macOS, and Windows. v0.13.0.

## What it is
- Local-first log anomaly detection (nothing leaves the host; offline/air-gapped capable)
- Three detection modes: fast, turbo, and deep (neural)
- Incident grouping, explainable alerts, opt-in AI root-cause analysis (summaries only)
- CI/CD integration with stable exit codes; offline HTML reports

## Install
- macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LoglensAI/LogLens-AI/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
- Windows: irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LoglensAI/LogLens-AI/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
- Python: pipx install loglensai
- Docker: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/data" loglensai/loglens analyze --source app.log

## Source & packages
- GitHub: https://github.com/LoglensAI/LogLens-AI
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/loglensai/
